location: Fully remote (U.S.); not eligible for immigration sponsorship - must be authorized to work in the U.S. for any employer
job_description:
Community Health Systems is seeking a highly specialized Oracle Enterprise Data Scientist to drive data quality, standardization, and insight generation across its core Oracle operational suite. The role is the authoritative expert on translating complex, high-volume data from Oracle Supply Chain Management (SCM), Procurement, Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), and Inventory into actionable business intelligence, ensuring absolute data integrity in a regulated healthcare environment and transforming raw transactional data into operational reports, interactive dashboards, and predictive models that optimize cost-per-case, inventory accuracy, and the revenue cycle.

Essential functions:
- Data validation, integrity, and compliance: design automated data validation frameworks for healthcare operations; develop monitoring to detect anomalies affecting regulatory reporting, financial audits (SOX), and GPO/payer compliance; validate the link between inventory consumption (SCM) and patient billing (RCM) to prevent charge-capture errors and revenue leakage; perform root-cause analysis on Oracle Fusion configuration errors.
- Standardized operational analytics: define and institutionalize KPIs (inventory accuracy, procurement compliance/off-contract spend, days of supply, cost-per-case variance, claims denial rate); build standardized reports and dashboards (Tableau, Power BI) for OR, clinics, and purchasing; create executive insight reports.
- Advanced modeling and process optimization: predictive inventory modeling for demand volatility; revenue-cycle modeling for cash flow and denial forecasting; ML-based logistics and procurement optimization.
- Collaboration: serve as technical data expert for Oracle functional teams (Finance, Clinical Operations, Materials Management); document data lineage, metric definitions, and model methodologies.

Required qualifications: Master's in Data Science, Health Informatics, Statistics, Industrial Engineering, or related quantitative field; 2+ years in a specialized data science/BI/analytics role in a healthcare system, hospital, or payer; practical experience with at least two Oracle Fusion applications; expert SQL; Python or R; advanced visualization; EDW experience in a regulated environment.

Benefits: competitive compensation, PTO, comprehensive health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription), 401(k), education support and student loan assistance, life and disability insurance, and FSA.
company_details: Community Health Systems (CHS) is one of the nation's leading healthcare providers, operating healthcare delivery systems across 36 markets in 14 states. CHS runs 69 affiliated hospitals (10,000+ beds) and roughly 1,000 other sites of care, including physician practices, urgent care, freestanding EDs, imaging centers, cancer centers, and ambulatory surgery centers.

csv_row.Required Skills: Expert-level SQL for complex querying (including Oracle tables/views); Python or R with statistical modeling, time series analysis, and ML libraries; Oracle Fusion domain expertise in at least two of Oracle SCM & Inventory, Oracle Procurement, Oracle RCM (item masters, warehouse transactions, purchase orders, contract management, charge capture, billing linkage); data validation frameworks and data integrity; predictive modeling (demand forecasting, revenue-cycle/cash-flow forecasting, denial prediction); ML for logistics and procurement optimization; advanced visualization (Tableau, Power BI); large-scale Enterprise Data Warehouses (EDW) in regulated environments; healthcare KPI development. Preferred: clinical coding standards (CPT, ICD-10); HIPAA/HITECH and healthcare data governance; surgical/procedural analytics; Oracle applications or cloud certification.
csv_row.Years of Experience Required: 2+ years in a specialized data science, BI, or analytics role within a large healthcare system, hospital, or payer environment (Master's degree required)
